leaf_cases.note: 初审指出旧快照只有 head/meta、正文未落盘。复核旧快照 sources/3e37556b…txt：文件为 166,464 字节的 HTML，正文几乎全在同一行（仅 1 个换行，按行拆分共 2 行），正文确实含 “With multiple choice polls, people vote on predefined options and you can quickly see the prevailing answer”、“Let your participants vote from any device using a link or QR code and display the results in real time”、“export the results to Excel, PDF or Google Sheets”，并列出 multiple choice/word cloud/quiz/rating/open text/ranking/survey 类型；初审的“仅 meta 命中”与本次逐词检索结果不符。为避免超长单行 HTML 难以人读，本轮另抓官方帮助页 4f9b4b8d…（2026-10-25）并读取正文：“Select Multiple choice / Type in your question and answer options / Hit Start to run your poll instantly”、“display your poll results live”、“results are displayed as percentages”。据此问题+预置选项、低摩擦分发投票、计算聚合结果三项均有正文证据，保留 case_found。
